notes: Local real CLI benchmark, warm caches; no cold-cache claim. Baseline: installed git worktree add --detach; candidate: release git-twig add --detach.
One unmeasured warmup per backend. Backend order alternates per sample. Monotonic Instant measures CLI completion and first/warm/modified git status separately.
Full byte/mode-independent content verification after first/warm status. In-place write must leave source unchanged. Synthetic deterministic pseudo-random bytes; no compression/dedupe assumptions.
Every operation is retained on disk. Report exclusive physical storage as unmeasured. Logical fixture bytes are not APFS allocation.
All create/first-status/warm-status workers finish before any full-content verification or private-write check begins. Batch throughput excludes generator verification work, includes status calls.
Tail percentiles with few samples are descriptive only; errors or incorrect content block conclusions. No generator saturation claim at high concurrency.
